strategies.name: Detection Strategy for Spearphishing Voice across OS platforms

analytics.name: Analytic 0683
analytics.guidance: Monitor call log records from corporate devices for unusual or unauthorized numbers, especially repeated calls to/from known malicious phone numbers. Correlate with subsequent system events (e.g., browser navigation, remote management tool execution).

tuning.description: List of known malicious or suspicious phone numbers; must be tuned per environment
Threshold for correlating call events with subsequent suspicious system activity

log_sources.name: ApplicationLog:CallRecords
log_sources.channel: Outbound or inbound calls to high-risk or blocklisted numbers

analytics.name: Analytic 0684
analytics.guidance: Audit VoIP/SIP logs for suspicious outbound calls or call setup messages to unusual endpoints. Correlate with user activity such as browser execution or package installation following the call.

tuning.description: Regular expressions or rules for spotting abnormal call destinations
Expected users who initiate VoIP traffic vs. anomalous accounts

log_sources.name: networkdevice:syslog
log_sources.channel: SIP REGISTER, INVITE, or unusual call destination metadata

analytics.name: Analytic 0685
analytics.guidance: Monitor Facetime, iMessage, or SIP client logs for anomalous voice call attempts. Link to subsequent user execution events (downloads, RMM installs) triggered post-call.

tuning.description: Patterns of spoofed caller IDs that must be tuned based on region and telecom provider
Define what follow-on events (browser downloads, execution) to correlate with call logs

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Outgoing or incoming calls with non-standard caller IDs or unusual metadata

analytics.name: Analytic 0686
analytics.guidance: Correlate MFA push fatigue or unusual consent grant attempts with call activity where adversaries may have socially engineered the user over voice.

tuning.description: Number of MFA push requests within a timeframe aligned to a suspicious call
Unusual OAuth consent URLs or delegated scopes

log_sources.name: m365:unified
log_sources.channel: Unusual MFA requests or OAuth consent events temporally aligned with user-reported vishing call
